Package in.co.rays.proj4.model

Class BaseModel<T extends BaseBean>

java.lang.Object
in.co.rays.proj4.model.BaseModel<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of Bean extending BaseBean
Direct Known Subclasses:
ATMModel, CollegeModel, CourseModel, FacultyModel, GymModel, HospitalModel, LibraryModel, MarksheetModel, RailwayModel, RoleModel, StudentModel, SubjectModel, UserModel
public abstract class BaseModel<T extends BaseBean> extends Object
BaseModel is an abstract class that provides common database operations for all model classes. It supports adding, updating, deleting, searching, and retrieving records.
